phases.name: Model layer — pure functions and promoted primitives

steps.name: Promote CopyButton and SectionLabel from broadcast-details-card.tsx
steps.description: Extract CopyButton (lines 23–43) and SectionLabel (lines 45–47) from broadcast-details-card.tsx into desktop-app/src/components/copy-button.tsx and section-label.tsx respectively. Update broadcast-details-card.tsx imports so its rendered output is byte-identical.
criteria: desktop-app/src/components/copy-button.tsx exists and exports a CopyButton component with a string prop and a clipboard write + brief check-icon toggle behavior
desktop-app/src/components/section-label.tsx exists and exports a SectionLabel component for uppercase section-label typography
broadcast-details-card.tsx imports CopyButton and SectionLabel from their new locations and no longer defines them inline
npm run build completes without errors after the import changes
npm run lint and npm run format:check pass

steps.name: Create model pure functions: format-btc-from-sats, format-signed-sats, trunc-address, trunc-txid, relative-time
steps.description: Add five pure TypeScript functions under desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/. Each file has a single named export. relative-time.ts mirrors the existing relativeTime in broadcast-details-card.tsx but accepts an explicit now: Date parameter for testability.
criteria: formatBtcFromSats(0) returns '0.00000000'; formatBtcFromSats(100_000_000) returns '1.000000'; formatBtcFromSats(10_000_000_000) returns '100.0000'; formatBtcFromSats(NaN) returns '—'
formatSignedSats(1_234) returns '+1,234 sats'; formatSignedSats(-48_250_000) returns '−48,250,000 sats' with unicode minus; formatSignedSats(NaN) returns '—'
truncAddress('bc1pwxlpge5x8n3z7c0hcusmt2jy5fgq9kly6w0s2rflmakrgjtp0w0qxh66u2') returns a string of the form 'bc1pw…66u2'; addresses of length ≤ 14 pass through unchanged
truncTxid of a 64-char hex string returns a string of the form 'xxxxxxxx…xxxxxx'; strings of length ≤ 16 pass through unchanged

relativeTime given a date 30 seconds before now returns '30s ago'; 5 minutes before now returns '5m ago'; 2 hours before now returns '2h ago'; a future date returns 'just now'; an invalid ISO string returns '—'
No model file imports React or any component

steps.name: Create model aggregation functions: group-utxos-by-derivation, compose-addresses-with-balance, format-admin-wallet-error, view-models.ts
steps.description: Add four remaining model files under desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/. view-models.ts re-exports the AddressWithBalanceView type and selected mappers as the module's public surface.
criteria: groupUtxosByDerivation([]) returns an empty Map; groupUtxosByDerivation with two UTXOs at the same derivationIndex returns a Map entry with their valueSats summed; by default UTXOs with keychain === 'Internal' are excluded; passing opts { includeInternal: true } includes them

composeAddressesWithBalance given addresses with no matching UTXOs returns entries all with balanceSats === 0; an address at index 0 with a UTXO of 125_000_000 sats returns balanceSats: 125_000_000 for that entry

formatAdminWalletError returns severity 'info' for AdminWalletError.Disabled; severity 'warning' for RpcUnreachable and RpcAuthFailed and SyncIncomplete; severity 'fatal' for DescriptorParseError; severity 'info' for RegtestGuardViolation; every variant produces a non-empty title and body
view-models.ts exports the AddressWithBalanceView type and can be imported without importing React
No model file imports from domain/admin-wallet/components/ or domain/admin-wallet/hooks/

steps.name: Write test files for all 8 model functions and register as npm run test:model-* in package.json
steps.description: Create 8 test files under desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/__tests__/ following the existing tsx script pattern with node:assert/strict. Add model/__fixtures__/ with make-utxo, make-address, and make-sync-status typed builders. Register each as npm run test:model-<name> in desktop-app/package.json.
criteria: desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/__tests__/format-btc-from-sats.test.ts exists and all assertions pass via npm run test:model-format-btc-from-sats
desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/__tests__/format-signed-sats.test.ts exists and all assertions pass via npm run test:model-format-signed-sats
desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/__tests__/trunc-address.test.ts exists and all assertions pass via npm run test:model-trunc-address
desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/__tests__/trunc-txid.test.ts exists and all assertions pass via npm run test:model-trunc-txid
desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/__tests__/relative-time.test.ts exists and all assertions pass via npm run test:model-relative-time
desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/__tests__/group-utxos-by-derivation.test.ts exists and all assertions pass via npm run test:model-group-utxos-by-derivation
desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/__tests__/compose-addresses-with-balance.test.ts exists and all assertions pass via npm run test:model-compose-addresses-with-balance
desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/model/__tests__/format-admin-wallet-error.test.ts exists and all assertions pass via npm run test:model-format-admin-wallet-error
Fixture builders in model/__fixtures__/ are never imported by any production file under domain/admin-wallet/

phases.name: Hooks layer — URL state and composed view-model hook

steps.name: Create useWalletPanelState hook (URL search params via React Router 6)
steps.description: Add desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/hooks/use-wallet-panel-state.ts. The hook reads and writes ?wallet=open and ?walletSection=<section> via useSearchParams. Exports isOpen, expandedSection, open(), close(), and setExpandedSection().
criteria: useWalletPanelState with URL ?wallet=open&walletSection=addresses returns { isOpen: true, expandedSection: 'addresses' }
Calling open('receive') causes the URL to become ?wallet=open&walletSection=receive
Calling close() strips both wallet and walletSection params from the URL
An unknown walletSection value in the URL results in expandedSection: null without throwing
The hook has no direct imports from @tauri-apps/api/core or @/api/admin-wallet

steps.name: Create useAddressesWithBalance hook and write contract tests for both hooks
steps.description: Add desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/hooks/use-addresses-with-balance.ts. Compose useAdminWalletAddresses and useAdminWalletUtxos, then apply composeAddressesWithBalance. Add test files for both hooks under hooks/__tests__/ following the tsx script pattern and register as npm run test:hooks-* in package.json.
criteria: useAddressesWithBalance given mocked synchronous outputs from the two underlying hooks produces data equal to composeAddressesWithBalance(addresses, utxos)
useAddressesWithBalance isLoading is true when either underlying hook reports loading
useAddressesWithBalance error is the first non-null AdminWalletError from either underlying hook
npm run test:hooks-use-wallet-panel-state passes
npm run test:hooks-use-addresses-with-balance passes
Neither hook file imports @tauri-apps/api/core directly

phases.name: UI components — slide-over panel and wallet sections

steps.name: Create wallet-panel.tsx — slide-over container with focus trap, ESC, backdrop, and ARIA
steps.description: Port the Alta WalletPanel.jsx slide-over container to desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/components/wallet-panel.tsx. Implement 240 ms transition via double-RAF, focus trap cycling on Tab/Shift+Tab, document-level Escape listener, backdrop click to close, and focus restore on close. ARIA: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby=wallet-panel-title.
criteria: When isOpen becomes true the panel element has aria-modal='true' and role='dialog'
When isOpen is true pressing Escape calls onClose
When isOpen is true clicking the backdrop calls onClose
Tab key press while the panel is open cycles focus within the panel and does not reach elements behind the backdrop
When isOpen becomes false after being true focus is restored to the previously focused element
The component does not import from @tauri-apps/api/core or @/api/admin-wallet

steps.name: Create wallet-panel-header.tsx, wallet-panel-trigger.tsx, and disabled-wallet-card.tsx
steps.description: Add three supporting components. wallet-panel-header.tsx renders the panel title and close button with id=wallet-panel-title. wallet-panel-trigger.tsx renders the header toggle button. disabled-wallet-card.tsx renders the body-collapse info card for AdminWalletError.Disabled and RegtestGuardViolation.
criteria: wallet-panel-header.tsx renders an element with id='wallet-panel-title' containing the panel title text
wallet-panel-trigger.tsx renders a button; when isOpen is true the button reflects an open/active state; clicking calls onToggle
disabled-wallet-card.tsx renders the environment configuration message when given an AdminWalletError.Disabled error
disabled-wallet-card.tsx renders the typed message for AdminWalletError.RegtestGuardViolation
None of these components import from @tauri-apps/api/core

steps.name: Create wallet-balance.tsx, receive-address-row.tsx, and receive-section.tsx
steps.description: Add three content-section components. wallet-balance.tsx renders total balance with a BTC↔sats unit toggle. receive-address-row.tsx renders the first-unused external address with CopyButton. receive-section.tsx renders a toggle-expander leading to the address-copy block and a Phase 6 placeholder notice.
criteria: wallet-balance.tsx renders balanceSats formatted as BTC by default; clicking the unit toggle re-renders the value in sats using formatBtcFromSats and formatSignedSats from the model layer
wallet-balance.tsx shows a loading skeleton when isLoading is true
receive-address-row.tsx renders the given address string and includes a CopyButton that copies it to the clipboard
receive-section.tsx when collapsed shows only a toggle button; when expanded shows the address and the Phase 6 placeholder text
None of these components import from @tauri-apps/api/core or invoke IPC directly

steps.name: Create addresses-with-balance-list.tsx and address-row.tsx
steps.description: Add the collapsible addresses table. address-row.tsx renders a single row of (index, address, balanceSats, isUsed). addresses-with-balance-list.tsx renders a collapsible section header and a table of address-row entries driven by AddressWithBalanceView[].
criteria: addresses-with-balance-list.tsx is collapsed by default (the table is not visible until onToggle is called with isExpanded false → true)
When isExpanded is true each AddressWithBalanceView row is rendered via address-row.tsx showing index, truncated address, and formatted balanceSats
address-row.tsx renders isUsed state visually distinguishable from unused
addresses-with-balance-list.tsx shows a loading skeleton when isLoading is true and rows is null
When error is non-null and rows is null an error message is shown instead of the table

steps.name: Create tx-history-list.tsx, tx-history-item.tsx, send-placeholder.tsx, and sync-chip.tsx
steps.description: Add the remaining four panel section components. tx-history-list.tsx and tx-history-item.tsx are ported from Alta but render in empty state with Phase 5 copy. send-placeholder.tsx renders a disabled CTA with Phase 4 copy. sync-chip.tsx renders the last-sync relative-time label, a Refresh button, and typed error surfacing.
criteria: tx-history-list.tsx renders the Phase 5 placeholder message 'Transaction history arrives in Phase 5 (transactions + fee-bump).' and no data rows
send-placeholder.tsx renders a disabled CTA button and the Phase 4 message 'Send arrives in Phase 4 (regtest Send happy path).'
sync-chip.tsx given a syncStatus with a lastSyncedAt timestamp renders a relative-time string (e.g. '12s ago') using relativeTime from the model
sync-chip.tsx clicking the Refresh button calls onRefresh
sync-chip.tsx given an AdminWalletError.RpcUnreachable error renders 'Sync error: cannot reach Bitcoin node' instead of the relative time
sync-chip.tsx given an AdminWalletError.RpcAuthFailed error renders 'Sync error: RPC auth failed'
None of these components import from @tauri-apps/api/core

phases.name: Screen integration and architecture compliance test

steps.name: Wire WalletPanel into proposals-dashboard-screen.tsx
steps.description: Modify proposals-dashboard-screen.tsx to import useWalletPanelState and add WalletPanelTrigger to the ScreenShell headerContent slot and WalletPanel with its section children to the screen body. All Phase 2 hooks are consumed inside panel children.
criteria: The proposals dashboard screen renders a Wallet trigger button in the header
Clicking the Wallet trigger button causes the WalletPanel to become visible (isOpen state transitions to true)
The URL becomes ?wallet=open when the panel is opened from the dashboard
Loading the dashboard with ?wallet=open&walletSection=addresses in the URL renders the panel open with the addresses section expanded
npm run build passes with no TypeScript errors after the modification

steps.name: Wire WalletPanel into broadcast-proposal-screen.tsx
steps.description: Apply identical WalletPanel wiring to broadcast-proposal-screen.tsx. The panel children composition is the same as the dashboard; no WalletPanelBody abstraction is introduced (out of scope until a third call site appears).
criteria: The broadcast proposal screen renders a Wallet trigger button in the header
The WalletPanel behaves identically on the broadcast screen as on the dashboard: opens, closes, restores focus, and respects URL state
Existing broadcast screen functionality (proposal display, broadcast action) is unaffected by the addition
npm run build passes with no TypeScript errors after the modification

steps.name: Write architecture compliance test (grep-based) and register as npm run test:architecture
steps.description: Create desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/architecture.test.ts using the existing tsx script pattern. The test greps source files to assert dependency-direction rules. Register as npm run test:architecture in desktop-app/package.json.
criteria: npm run test:architecture passes and reports no violations
The test asserts that no file under domain/admin-wallet/components/ contains an import from @tauri-apps/api/core or @/api/admin-wallet
The test asserts that no file under domain/admin-wallet/model/ contains an import of 'react'
The test asserts that no production file under domain/admin-wallet/ (outside __tests__ and __fixtures__) contains an import from __fixtures__/
npm run lint, npm run format:check, and npm run build all pass on the final codebase
steps.scenario_name: Architecture compliance — dependency-direction rules for admin-wallet domain
